kind: repair campaign (TLSF), 3x2 factorial, all six arms from one binary
kind_note: Sweep U crosses an operator factor (reachoff / reach / reachburst) against a search-size factor (s = gen10/pop200, l = gen40/pop400). Every contrast is internal: both sides of each come from the same commit, unlike 2026-08-23-monotone, which paired against another campaign's archive across a binary change.
question: Whether the five assumption-construction keys added on feat/assumption-construction put the ideals of gyro-var1, gyro-var2 and lift inside the TLSF grammar's reach. All five ship at no-op values and all five were argued rather than measured; PLAN.md section 1 states the argument for each.
endpoint: Per-run implies_ideal, scored by compare against examples/<spec>/fixes, read with an exact two-sided McNemar test over the discordant pairs at alpha 0.05. The primary is confined to the three target families; the same contrast over the other 20 families is a regression gate. PLAN.md section 5.

arms.reachoff-s: max_assumption_width 1, p_bare_assumption 0.0, p_remove_assumption 0.0, p_union_assumption 0.0, p_burst_continue 0.0, generations 10, population 200
arms.reach-s: max_assumption_width 3, p_bare_assumption 0.25, p_remove_assumption 0.05, p_union_assumption 0.25, p_burst_continue 0.0, generations 10, population 200
arms.shared: accumulate_repairs true, nsga2-apportion, log metric, weakening screen off, p_monotone 0.25, p_clone_assumption 0.25, elitism_rate 0.1, 7200 s wall cap, compare_timeout 1800 s, jobs 8, 23 families at seeds 0-11

corpus_note: 23 families, not the 25 of H2H_TLSF_READY. humanoid-531 and humanoid-742 were excluded before launch as time-limited rather than grammar-limited; PLAN.md section 4 records the exclusion and its cost basis. Anything reading across this archive and 2026-08-23-monotone reads over 23 families on this side.
decision_rule_firing: None of PLAN.md section 5's three outcomes fires as written, and that is recorded rather than smoothed over. Outcome 1 needs the primary at p < 0.05 and it reads 1.0000. Outcome 2 needs reachoff-s at zero on the target families and it repairs gyro-var2@7. Outcome 3 needs reach-s at zero and it repairs gyro-var2@2. The design assumed a control pinned at zero on all three targets, which the monotone campaign's 8 of 60 on gyro-var2 had already made unsafe. The numbers are unambiguous where the rule is silent: the target rate is 1 of 36 on both sides.
decision: All five keys ship at their no-op values -- max_assumption_width 1, p_bare_assumption 0.0, p_remove_assumption 0.0, p_union_assumption 0.0, p_burst_continue 0.0 -- which is outcome 3's action reached by reading the numbers rather than by the rule firing. p_burst_continue stays off with a measured pooled loss behind it (13 gained against 29 lost, p = 0.0195) rather than an argument. The operators are kept in the tree at those values because each costs no RandomSource draw when unarmed, so the shipping breeding stream is byte-identical to the one before they existed, and because two reachability results are worth keeping the code for.

reachability_findings.lift: Repaired for the first time in the project's history. 0 of 60 across all three arms of 2026-08-23-monotone, and here 3 of 12 under reach-l against 0 of 12 for its own control, 3 gained and none lost. Its ideal is G F (b1 || b2 || b3), a width-3 disjunction, which is exactly the shape max_assumption_width = 3 was written to emit. PLAN.md section 6 named lift as reachable only through that key before the run.
reachability_findings.lily11: 5 of 12 to 11 of 12 on the primary contrast. PLAN.md section 6 named it as reachable only through p_bare_assumption before the run; its whole ideal is a bare F req, and G F req is strictly stronger.
reachability_findings.gyro-var1: Unmoved at 0 of 72 across all six arms.
reachability_findings.gyro-var2: Its gains track search size rather than the operators: the no-op control reads 7 of 12 at large size against the armed arm's 3 of 12. Its ideal is a ~29-node conjunct that is verbatim a conjunct of gyro-var1's specification (and vice versa), so the material p_union_assumption unions is in a sibling specification no run ever sees.

owed: The 2^4 separating max_assumption_width, p_bare_assumption, p_remove_assumption and p_union_assumption. PLAN.md section 6 registered the bundling knowingly; the per-family reads on lift and lily11 carry information the sweep does not, and cannot rescue the primary.

The p_monotone tuning campaign, already owed before this one and now with a measurement behind it: counter's best_relation reads equivalent on 1.1% of runs against AuRUS's 33.8%, and rules_at in src/tlsf/mutation.cpp gives an Atom only the Constant weakening, where AuRUS's FormulaWeakening applies a -> a|b at a literal.

Why 9x the search budget buys nothing. reachoff-s to reachoff-l is 40 generations against 10 and 400 population against 200, 357 s median wall against 39 s, and moves implies_ideal from 150 to 154 of 271 at p = 0.6358. Every grammar change runs into this before it runs into anything else.
config_vintage: No entry is owed in the 'Config vintage' note of experiments/README.md, which supersedes PLAN.md section 10's expectation of five. All five keys are new and all five default to a no-op value, so an archived config that omits them means exactly what it meant before they existed. A vintage entry is for a default that moved, not for a key that arrived.

profile_commit.subject: feat(tlsf): five operators for assumption reach and coordinated edits
profile_commit.reachable_from_main_note: Reachable once the branch's pull request merges. The branch merges rather than being split into reconstructed pull requests, so no provenance/* tag is needed; see provenance/replicate-campaign for the case where one is.

binary_commit.source: counter --version, read by run_experiments.py at startup and stamped onto every row
binary_commit.rows_agree: Rows carry two commit values: 0510b31 for seeds 0-7 and 8b3cb23 for the top-up seeds 8-11. The diff between them touches PLAN.md, campaign.toml and scripts/run_experiments.py and no file under src/, include/ or test/, so both halves came from an identical binary and the seeds pair across the split.

hosts.note: Both staged and launched through scripts/campaign.py's queue, so each binary's commit was verified against the checkout before the phase ran. Seeds 0-7 ran as queue entry 009 at 0510b31 and finished 2026-08-26T10:32:22 (av2) and 10:31:11 (av3); the top-up ran as entry 010 at 8b3cb23. The split is declared in campaign.toml, phase 2 carrying its own hosts table.

rows.shortfall_note: 10 of 1656 cells were not run. All ten are large-arm runs of pcar-v2-888, prioritized-arbiter-aurus and round-robin-arbiter-aurus, families that hit the 7200 s wall cap; the campaign was closed on the user's instruction with those in flight. No target-family cell is affected, and all three -s arms are complete at 276 of 276, so the primary, the regression gate and the burst contrast are final rather than provisional. The three -l arms hold 271, 274 and 273 of 276.
rows.complete_cells_note: Every contrast above is taken over the 271 (spec, seed) cases present in all six arms, so the arms are comparable column to column and not only within a paired contrast.

primary_reachoff_s_to_reach_s_target.note: The registered primary. All three -s arms are complete at 276 of 276 runs, so this contrast is final.
